summary: Supported simple-let application heads discard their CFA occurrence token and remain TOP.
evidence: register_application creates a token and expression_cell supports Texp_let (Nonrecursive,[binding],body), but record_head attaches cfa_application_token only for Texp_ifthenelse, Texp_match, Texp_sequence, and Texp_apply at lines 2640-2645. A supported call such as (let f = target in f) x therefore falls through lines 2657-2660 to Head_unknown; expand_cfa_calls never reads its resolved token, so the physical call misses target despite the shared dispatcher resolving it.
fix: Route supported Texp_let heads through the CFA-marker branch (unsupported let shapes already become callback uncertainty in expression_cell) and add authentic main/flat coverage for a saturated simple-let head, including exact occurrence metadata and retained frontier controls.
